scope: Perfect synthetic single-page PaddleX 3.7.2-shaped JSON through official Docling 2.132.0 importer, Docling JSON round-trip and stock Markdown export; no provider or model behavior measured.
cases: missing image bytes and caption association
invalid geometry and ambiguous multipage rejection

requirements.code: Exact literal text and indentation, usable Markdown code delivery
requirements.inline_math: LaTeX retained in prose or correctly associated inline within its source paragraph
requirements.table: Header roles and spans retained in JSON; document Markdown remains usable
requirements.picture: Picture source bytes and caption association explicitly checked
requirements.provenance: Preserve page and bbox; do not claim original PDF point coordinates or source digest from placeholder origin
